method: Actual image inspection through view_image; no producer renderer called and no image values inferred from metrics

per_view_observations.shade_edit: The edited circumferential strokes are visibly heavier, especially the lower central stack and the right-hand curved segments. Positions and broad spacing appear unchanged.
per_view_observations.whole_object: Full shade, long thin stem and elliptical base are present with surrounding white margins. The stem retains several separated vertical lines; the base retains short crossing strokes.
per_view_observations.retained_defects: Several shade strokes sit very close together in the lower center. Base strokes form a darker crossing chain along the front edge. The top rim and thin shade lines show raster irregularity.

per_view_observations.shade_edit: The width increase is particularly easy to see in the central and lower-right bands. Nearby strokes become darker stacks, but the shade remains readable and mostly open white space.
per_view_observations.whole_object: All three parts remain distinguishable and nonempty. The edited panel shows no apparent change to stem length, base stroke layout or lamp framing.
per_view_observations.retained_defects: Dense paired shade lines and the dark crossing chain at the base front remain visible; the result is not a uniform or polished hand-drawn texture.

per_view_observations.shade_edit: The heavier width is visible at the lower-left shade edge and in central curved fragments. The edit does not appear to introduce extra connecting strokes between parts.
per_view_observations.whole_object: The complete lamp is in frame. The stem remains thin and vertically hatched; base crossing strokes remain visible, with an open patch near the front center.
per_view_observations.retained_defects: Shade dark stacks and light fragments have uneven visual weight. Base coverage remains patchy and the front rim is comparatively exposed.

per_view_observations.shade_edit: The edit is subtler because many shade strokes are light, but paired comparison shows visibly stronger horizontal curves, especially near the lower-left side and central rows.
per_view_observations.whole_object: Shade, stem and base are all visible, nonempty and fully framed. The three stroke directions remain distinct.
per_view_observations.retained_defects: The shade retains pale thin segments, occasional close parallel traces and raster stepping. The base remains irregularly spaced rather than evenly shaded.

edit_contact_sheet_observations.frames_00_to_11: All twelve tiles show the thinner-shade state with a complete lamp in consistent framing.
edit_contact_sheet_observations.frames_12_to_23: All twelve tiles show the stronger-shade state with the same full-lamp framing. The intended visible step occurs between the two groups.
edit_contact_sheet_observations.first_middle_last: The first tile has lighter shade strokes; middle and last have visibly heavier shade strokes. Stem and base show no obvious visual change.
edit_contact_sheet_observations.motion_or_flicker_conclusion: NOT_ESTABLISHED; these are static contact sheets of a fixed-camera edit, not temporal correspondence or playback evidence

This supports the practical edit/save/replay software slice; it does not establish reconstruction quality, temporal stability or resolve the inherited density failure.
limitations: This review is qualitative and covers four previously exposed views of one authored GT lamp.
Contact-sheet thumbnails can conceal individual pixel defects; original512px edited PNGs were also inspected for all four views.
No numerical leakage, exact output equality, width calibration, depth correctness or camera-motion stability is inferred from appearance alone.
No video playback or new orbit/zoom sequence was reviewed here; the24-frame sheet only exposes a fixed-camera before/after edit.
Retained shade overlaps and base edge crossings remain visible; a functional width edit is not evidence that these quality defects are solved.
